Before Asking AI, Imagine a World Without It――調べ方は誰のものか

Before asking AI to research something, imagine how you would do it without AI. その逆説的な習慣を、情報評価・学習実験・自動化研究から検証する。The goal is not to reject AI, but to know which parts of your thinking you are delegating—and which new questions AI makes possible.
